episodes.name: About Three Years Later
episodes.overview: Jess and Nick come back from a book tour for "The Pepperwood Chronicles" across Europe.

episodes.name: Tuesday Meeting
episodes.overview: Over a drunken power lunch, Jess and Cece decide to stand up to Russell and demand Jess be given more responsibility in her new job. Meanwhile, Nick struggles to come up with ideas for a new book and Schmidt is desperate to get Ruth to sleep.

episodes.name: Lillypads
episodes.overview: Nervous about Ruth's interview at a prestigious pre-school, Schmidt recruits Jess to help her prepare. Meanwhile, Nick procrastinates writing, and Winston prepares to confront his fear of testifying in court.

episodes.name: Where the Road Goes
episodes.overview: The gang gathers for a one-year memorial service for a beloved friend. Meanwhile, Jess discovers Coach owes Nick a large sum of money.

episodes.name: Godparents
episodes.overview: Jess tries to appease Winston's anxiety about his impending fatherhood by tracking down his long lost dad. Meanwhile, Schmidt goes back to work for the first time since Ruth's birth.

episodes.name: Mario
episodes.overview: Nick's plan to propose to Jess is thrown off-course when they decide to get a dog, Winston sees color for the first time and Schmidt worries about Cece getting pregnant again.

episodes.name: The Curse of the Pirate Bride
episodes.overview: Jess and Nick make two life-changing decisions and Winston and Aly's big day arrives.

episodes.name: Engram Pattersky
episodes.overview: The gang takes a tour down memory lane, which includes a final round of "True American."
